name: Radar Amplifier - First Strike
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's First Strike capability.

61181.name: TacW Guidance II · First Strike
61181.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
On the <color=#F74848>1st</color> active attack per turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
